title: Fix verified release package build before zip
summary: Fixes release package verification blockers that prevented Create Deployment with Verify and Zip from reaching the zip creation step.
reason: A failed package from 2026-06-13 showed release verification exiting before zip creation because package-mode dependency checks were blocked by a new network core-to-desktop import and by optional network discovery dependency checks tied to the operator's local NetworkRole.
behavior_before: Create Deployment with Verify and Zip could leave a complete release folder and manifest but no zip because release self-test exited before the zip step.
behavior_after: Release self-test keeps normal operator environment checks strict, but package verification treats missing optional network discovery dependencies as advisory, and network lifecycle code no longer adds new core-to-desktop dependency findings.
manual_validation: check_dependency_boundaries --max-internal-imports 1 - passed with unallowlisted hard findings: 0
release build -Zip -Verify -IncludeTauriPreviewBinary to MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO_2026.06.04.001_Portable_codex_zipfix_20260614_000001 - passed; zip written

validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only for unrelated uncovered dependency-atlas image files: docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_core_library.png, docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_core_library.svg, docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_desktop_watch.png, docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_desktop_watch.svg
verify-env.ps1 -AllowMissingConfig -ReleasePackageVerification - passed; worker-mode zeroconf warning advisory
rollback_plan: Revert the touched release verifier, environment verifier, network lifecycle import, and focused test updates, then rerun release self-test/package build validation.
notes:
Change packet opened after reproducing the 2026-06-13 package verifier failure from MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO_2026.06.04.001_Portable_20260613_205854.
Replaced network lifecycle desktop imports with core kernel imports and added package-only optional-network verification mode.
Refreshed summaries for touched release/network/test/change files.
Strict change coverage was rerun after the verified zip build; MP-CHANGE-2026-0614-001 files are covered, but unrelated generated dependency-atlas image files remain dirty outside any unreleased packet.
